# Runs Cypress e2e tests on GitHub Actions
#
# Secret configuration (MUST be configured at github project level: Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions -> Repository secrets):
#
# - TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY: tailscale API key required in order to access Erigon nodes inside our tailscale dev env
# - E2E_ERIGON_URL: JSON-RPC endpoint URL, e.g., http://erigon-node:8545
# - E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY: Cypress API key
name: End-to-End Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  push:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  check-secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      e2e-erigon-url: ${{ steps.e2e-erigon-url.outputs.defined }}
      e2e-cypress-record-key: ${{ steps.e2e-cypress-record-key.outputs.defined }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if E2E_ERIGON_URL is available
        id: e2e-erigon-url
        env:
          E2E_ERIGON_URL: ${{ secrets.E2E_ERIGON_URL }}
        if: "${{ env.E2E_ERIGON_URL != '' }}"
        run: echo "defined=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Check if E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY is available
        id: e2e-cypress-record-key
        env:
          E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY }}
        if: "${{ env.E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY != '' }}"
        run: echo "defined=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  e2e-test-mainnet:
    name: Run E2E tests on mainnet
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    if: ${{ needs.check-secrets.outputs.e2e-erigon-url == 'true' }}
    needs: [check-secrets]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - name: Install node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: ".nvmrc"
          cache: "pnpm"
      - name: Install packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Set up xvfb
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y libgtk2.0-0t64 libgtk-3-0t64 libgbm-dev libnotify-dev libnss3 libxss1 libasound2t64 libxtst6 xauth xvfb

      - name: Install Tailscale
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ubuntu/noble.noarmor.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/tailscale-archive-keyring.gpg >/dev/null
          curl -fsSL https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ubuntu/noble.tailscale-keyring.list | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/tailscale.list
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y tailscale
          sudo tailscale up --authkey=${{ secrets.TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY }} --hostname=gh-cypress --accept-routes

      - name: Confirm Tailscale is up
        run: tailscale status

      - name: Run Cypress tests on mainnet
        uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
        with:
          start: pnpm start
          wait-on: "http://localhost:5173"
          spec: "cypress/e2e/mainnet/**/*.cy.ts,cypress/e2e/*.cy.ts"
          tag: ${{needs.check-secrets.outputs.e2e-cypress-record-key == 'true' && 'mainnet' || ''}}
          record: |
            ${{needs.check-secrets.outputs.e2e-cypress-record-key == 'true' && 'true' || 'false'}}
        env:
          VITE_ERIGON_URL: ${{secrets.E2E_ERIGON_URL}}
          CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY: ${{secrets.E2E_CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY}}
      - name: Upload screenshots/videos from failing tests
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: Cypress Mainnet Screenshots
          path: |
            cypress/screenshots
            cypress/videos

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
